title: The room is not outside the One.
summary: Loneliness and control both shrink when you remember that all beings already stand inside Divine life.
takeaway: Nothing in the room is abandoned to itself.
lifeApplication: In one hard conversation today, quietly remember that everyone in it already belongs to the same Source.

source.shortMeaning: All beings already live within the One.
source.lifeApplication: Belonging is ontological before it becomes emotional.
